data.content_ref: inline:SRC_002 sidesteps the problem entirely. The problem asks 'when it may later be resumed without corrupting the append-only identity of the recorded events, and when resumption must stay refused.' Treating resumption as 'a new derived branch rather than a continuation' is not resumption at all — it is launching a separate run. The causal mechanism offered is only that 'the original stream is immutable,' which is trivially true of any append-only log and says nothing about whether the branch preserves causal continuity with the exhausted run's intermediate state. Furthermore, by declaring resumption 'always permissible,' SRC_002 provides no refusal criterion, failing to 'adjudicate between rival criteria' or determine when resumption must stay refused as the problem demands.
